partners.mechanism_chain: COL7A1 (HGNC:2197) —DISRUPTS→ Extracellular Matrix Organization (GO:0030198); Extracellular Matrix Organization (GO:0030198) —LEADS_TO→ Blistering skin (HP:0001041); SERPINA1 (HGNC:10589) —DISRUPTS→ Proteostasis (GO:0042724); Proteostasis (GO:0042724) —LEADS_TO→ Emphysema (HP:0002095); Proteostasis (GO:0042724) —LEADS_TO→ Liver disease (HP:0001391).
